title: Done round 8: website and tour, basic flow
brief:
Read <scratch> first; <dir> is that folder and <you> is "jamie". This is a basic-flow check of our own demo app (localhost, simulated PayPal, demo accounts). You are the only tester using the browser.
Use the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* tools; open your own tab with tabs_create; if a page shows you signed in as someone else, sign out first). At desktop width, go to http://127.0.0.1:8810/ and: (1) run the Judge tour from the Demo panel to the end — does every step complete? how long did it take? do the photos show a credit line and do any checks say MODEL? (2) sign up as a new customer "Jamie" at ZIP 78751 with a PIN you choose, post "My kitchen sink drains super slowly", accept an offer, approve the simulated PayPal hold, use the job's demo "finish now", and confirm/pay when asked (enter your PIN if asked); (3) open the job's Reports panel and the close-out package; (4) open "How we tested it" (/live-test) and "Photo credits" (/credits). Report to <dir>/reports/jamie.md: which steps worked, which failed (with what you saw), and the money shown at the end. Keep it under ~70 tool calls.
